title: NovoFab Double Column Band Saws, 11″ to 23-5/8″ — Value Line | NovoTech
meta_description: NovoFab Machinery double-column band saws in Canada: NF-DC 11 series (manual feed, mitre, automatic and variable speed), gear-driven NF-DC 14 / 16 and NF-DC 20 / 24 gantry saws for plate and bundles. Specs in inches and mm.
intro: Twin-column saws at value-line prices: the bow travels vertically on two columns, so the cut stays square in solid bar, blocks and bundles. The NF-DC 11 series offers manual feed, a 45° mitre version and two automatics; the NF-DC 14 and 16 add gear drive and hydraulic blade tension; the NF-DC 20 and 24 are gantry saws for plate up to 47-1/4″ wide.
hero_points: Twin-column guidance for square cuts in heavy stock
Hydraulic down-feed and clamping on every model; automatic feed on the NF-DC 11 A / AV
Round capacities from Ø11″ (280 mm) to Ø23-5/8″ (600 mm)
hero_brand_line: NovoFab Machinery is NovoTech's own value line: proven designs built to our specification, with CSA-approved panels, a 1-year warranty and parts and support from Mississauga.

groups.title: NovoFab Machinery double-column band saws
groups.lead: Twin-column saws from Ø11″ to Ø23-5/8″ (280–600 mm): hydraulic semi-automatics, a mitre version, automatics with shuttle vise and gantry saws for plate and bundles.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoFab Machinery double-column band saws

faq.q: Why choose a double-column saw over a pivot saw?
faq.a: Rigidity and capacity. The bow is guided on two columns, so there is no side load on the blade — cuts stay square in large solids and the blade lasts longer. The NF-DC 20 and 24 gantry saws also take plate and bundles a pivot bow cannot.

The NF-DC 11 A and NF-DC 11 AV feed and cut automatically with a shuttle vise; the AV adds stepless blade speed and a chip conveyor. The NF-DC 11, 11 T, 14, 16, 20 and 24 are hydraulic semi-automatics with manual material feed.

faq.q: Can a NovoFab double-column saw cut miters?
faq.a: The NF-DC 11 T swivels for cuts at 30° and 45° (Ø10-1/4″ and Ø6-3/4″). The other NF-DC models are straight-cut saws.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
